tasks.title: cubeos-init.service systemd unit + first-boot detection + swarm init
tasks.prompt: FIRST: read spec/001-boot-sequence/{requirements.md, design.md, acceptance/boot.feature}. SECOND: implement /etc/systemd/system/cubeos-init.service + /usr/local/bin/cubeos-init.sh in the hal/ repo. (REQ-100/105/106/108) Detect first-boot vs recovery-boot via /cubeos/data/.setup_complete. (REQ-100) First-boot only: `docker swarm init --task-history-limit 1`. (REQ-117) Verify SQLite integrity on boot, restore from last-known-good if corrupted. (REQ-120) On boot-complete, append structured event to /cubeos/data/audit.log. Test on Pi 5 cold boot.
tasks.acceptance_test: ssh root@<pi-test-host> 'systemctl status cubeos-init.service && cat /cubeos/data/audit.log | tail -1 | jq .event' returns 'boot-complete'

tasks.title: Boot-state API (GET /api/v1/system/boot) + audit-log writer
tasks.prompt: FIRST: read spec/001-boot-sequence/{requirements.md, design.md}. SECOND: implement api/internal/handlers/system_boot.go with GET /api/v1/system/boot returning {phase, started_at, coreapps:[{name,status,started_at,completed_at,error?}], total_ms?} per REQ-114. Include full Swagger annotations per Article XII. Read state from /cubeos/data/boot-state.json (written by cubeos-init.sh per task T-001). (REQ-120) Append to audit.log on boot-complete. Table-driven tests covering: first-boot incomplete, first-boot complete, recovery-boot with one failed coreapp.

tasks.title: Boot-progress UI + first-boot wizard route + slow-boot warning
tasks.prompt: FIRST: read spec/001-boot-sequence/{requirements.md, design.md, acceptance/boot.feature}. SECOND: in dashboard/src/views/ implement BootProgressView.vue (REQ-115) polling /api/v1/system/boot every 2s; render per-coreapp status. Implement SetupWizardView.vue (REQ-106/107) shown when .setup_complete=false. Implement RecoveryWizardView.vue (REQ-117) shown when boot reports unrecoverable DB. (REQ-112/113) When total_ms > 90000, render slow-boot warning banner with link to /cubeos/data/boot.log download. Vue 3 Composition API + Tailwind per Article XIII of meshsat-hub constitution and CubeOS dashboard conventions.
tasks.acceptance_test: cd dashboard && npm run test -- boot.spec.ts
